headline: Gold Lounge gets one-week suspension and $500 fine over underage drinking; Mamasita receives written warning.
summary: Gold Lounge's one-week suspension starts on the 17th, and its hours are rolled back to 11:30 until December 31. Mamasita's written warning follows an underage drinking incident on September 6th, 2026. Four other licensing items were also approved, including the Envy Lounge transfer at 596 Essex Street.
decisions: Approved transfer of the Envy Lounge liquor license.
Approved change of manager, officers, and DBA name for Attika Restaurant at 1 Miller Street.
Approved a one-week suspension, a $500 fine, and rolling back Gold Lounge's hours to 11:30 until December 31.
Approved common victualler license for Panaderia el Chapin, 261-265 Broadway.
Approved a one-day alcohol license for Limonenses Unidos en el Exterior for an event on the 29th.
Approved a written warning for Mamasita over underage drinking.
discussion: Gold Lounge incident: Discussion covered underage drinking, a locked front door, and how long police waited before entering. Concerns were raised about public safety and whether drinks were still served after police arrived.

Mamasita incident: Discussion focused on out-of-country IDs, a security guard carrying handcuffs, and a closed door with patrons inside. Officers said security should stand outside when doors are closed.
Appeal rights for Gold Lounge: The one-week suspension can be appealed to the ABCC within five business days. The hours rollback can be challenged only in Superior Court.
